prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input: Image1 is the entire original Silent Storm opaque equipment diffuse atlas enlarged exactly8x nearest-neighbor solely to reveal source shape.
Request: Faithful HD material reconstruction; return the complete same square1:1 flat opaque UV atlas only.
Source inventory: Green olive cloth backpack atlas. Preserve original large smooth left rounded panel, right wrinkled front panel with exactly TWO original upper vertical straps and their existing pale glints/buckle openings, bottom-left original rolled-cloth strip with its existing dark wraps and ONE curled end at lower-right. Keep original two-strap cadence and actual source wrinkle positions. No new straps, holes, roll rings, pockets or stitching.
UV/content lock: Every contour, island, gap, seam, baked fold/shadow, mark and existing detail stays at exact normalized coordinates with identical count, shape and scale. No crop, zoom, margins, rotation, repacking or bbox registration. Preserve all source materials and opaque black padding. Do not infer extra objects from texture fragments.
Material detail: Fine smooth irregular non-repeating material grain only, at original surface scale. No visible crosshatch, herringbone, weave, decorative loops or regular diagonal texture pattern at full output size. Plain felt/cloth/leather and painted metal must remain plain. No curled, swirling, embossed, decorative, ornamental or repeating patterns, no ornamental strokes at any scale. Smooth original compression blocks without retaining block grids or converting them into geometric seams. Retain only existing fold/shadow topology; do not add wrinkles, folds or outlined patches. The new micrograin must be fine, plain and irregular, without recognizable ornamental curves. Keep source muted palette/dark exposure, later brightness matched numerically.
Avoid: New hardware, screws, rivets, buttons, holes, eyelets, lacing, stripes, ribs, stitching, patches, damage, labels, letters, logos, insignia or any invented recognizable component. No rendered item, perspective, scene or artistic redesign. Preserve exact source detail cadence, UV layout and material identity.
